from manim import *
from manim_voiceover import VoiceoverScene
from manim_voiceover.services.gtts import GTTSService
import numpy as np
import math

class PedagogicalScene848(VoiceoverScene):
    MARGIN = 0.5

    def fit_in_frame(self, mob: Mobject, w_frac=0.9, h_frac=0.9) -> Mobject:
        max_w = config.frame_width * w_frac
        max_h = config.frame_height * h_frac
        if mob.width > max_w:
            mob.width = max_w
        if mob.height > max_h:
            mob.height = max_h
        return mob

    def construct(self):
        self.set_speech_service(GTTSService(transcription_model="base"))
        
        # [SETUP]
        title = Title(r"Taylor Series of $f(x) = e^x$ around $x=0$")
        self.fit_in_frame(title)
        
        # [LAYOUT]
        ax = Axes(x_range=[-3, 3, 1], y_range=[-1, 8, 2], x_length=6, y_length=4)
        exp_curve = ax.plot(lambda x: np.exp(x), color=WHITE)
        exp_label = MathTex(r"e^x").next_to(ax.c2p(2, np.exp(2)), RIGHT)
        
        degree_tracker = ValueTracker(1)
        
        def get_taylor_poly(x):
            n = int(degree_tracker.get_value())
            return sum(x**k / math.factorial(k) for k in range(n + 1))
            
        taylor_curve = always_redraw(lambda: ax.plot(
            lambda x: get_taylor_poly(x), 
            color=BLUE if degree_tracker.get_value() == 1 else GREEN if degree_tracker.get_value() == 2 else YELLOW
        ))
        
        # [UPDATER]
        degree_label = DecimalNumber(1, num_decimal_places=0)
        degree_label.add_updater(lambda m: m.set_value(degree_tracker.get_value()))
        degree_text = MathTex(r"\text{Degree: }").next_to(degree_label, LEFT)
        degree_group = VGroup(degree_text, degree_label).to_corner(UR, buff=self.MARGIN)
        
        self.fit_in_frame(VGroup(ax, exp_curve, exp_label, taylor_curve, degree_group))

        # [BEAT 1 | sync: b1]
        with self.voiceover(text="The Taylor series expansion of e to the x around x equals zero <bookmark mark='b1'/>") as t:
            self.wait_until_bookmark("b1")
            self.play(Write(title), Create(ax), Create(exp_curve), Write(exp_label))
            
        # [BEAT 2 | sync: b2]
        with self.voiceover(text="We can approximate this curve with polynomials. <bookmark mark='b2'/> Here is the linear approximation, degree one.") as t:
            self.wait_until_bookmark("b2")
            self.play(Create(taylor_curve), Write(degree_group), run_time=1.5)
            self.wait(0.5)
            
        # [BEAT 3 | sync: b3]
        with self.voiceover(text="Adding the quadratic term improves the fit. <bookmark mark='b3'/>") as t:
            self.wait_until_bookmark("b3")
            self.play(degree_tracker.animate.set_value(2), run_time=1.5)
            self.wait(0.5)
            
        # [BEAT 4 | sync: b4]
        with self.voiceover(text="And adding the cubic term makes it even closer to the true exponential curve.") as t:
            self.play(degree_tracker.animate.set_value(3), run_time=1.5)
            self.wait(2)

from manim import *
from manim_voiceover import VoiceoverScene
from manim_voiceover.services.gtts import GTTSService
import numpy as np

class SciComputeScene1248(VoiceoverScene):
    MARGIN = 0.5

    def fit_in_frame(self, mob: Mobject, w_frac=0.9, h_frac=0.9) -> Mobject:
        max_w = config.frame_width * w_frac
        max_h = config.frame_height * h_frac
        if mob.width > max_w:
            mob.width = max_w
        if mob.height > max_h:
            mob.height = max_h
        return mob

    def construct(self):
        self.set_speech_service(GTTSService(transcription_model="base"))
        
        # [SETUP]
        title = Title("Eigenvector Transformation")
        self.fit_in_frame(title)
        
        # [LAYOUT]
        plane = NumberPlane(x_range=[-4, 4, 1], y_range=[-3, 3, 1])
        A = np.array([[2.0, 1.0], [1.0, 2.0]])
        eigenvalues, eigenvectors = np.linalg.eig(A)
        
        v1 = eigenvectors[:, 0]
        v2 = eigenvectors[:, 1]
        
        vec1 = Arrow(ORIGIN, plane.c2p(v1[0], v1[1]), color=RED, buff=0)
        vec2 = Arrow(ORIGIN, plane.c2p(v2[0], v2[1]), color=GREEN, buff=0)
        
        label_v1 = MathTex(r"\mathbf{v}_1", color=RED).next_to(vec1.get_end(), UP)
        label_v2 = MathTex(r"\mathbf{v}_2", color=GREEN).next_to(vec2.get_end(), RIGHT)
